My work is mainly about testing and preparing VAS services for release, then checking that everything continues to work properly after deployment.

  • Test APIs and service flows before release.
  • Work on service definitions and configuration during service setup.
  • Support deployments and check changes after they go live.
  • Use SecureCRT logs to trace issues and understand what is happening in a service flow.
  • Use TeamViewer when remote access or troubleshooting is needed.
  • Work on VAS campaigns and service releases that have successfully gone live.
